JOB DESCRIPTION
Full Stack Developer
Department: Engineering / Product Development | Employment: Full-time
Role Overview
We are looking for a motivated Full Stack Developer to design, develop, test, and maintain responsive web applications. The
ideal candidate can work across frontend and backend systems, build reliable APIs, manage databases, collaborate with
design and product teams, and contribute to secure, scalable software delivery.
Key Responsibilities
• Build and maintain responsive, accessible user interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and a framework such as React.
• Develop backend services and RESTful APIs using Node.js/Express, Python/Django or FastAPI, Java/Spring Boot, or an
equivalent stack.
• Design, query, and maintain relational or NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB.
• Implement authentication, authorization, input validation, error handling, and secure coding practices.
• Integrate third-party APIs and services, and troubleshoot frontend/backend integration issues.
• Write clean, maintainable, testable code; participate in code reviews and document technical decisions.
• Use Git for version control and collaborate through branches, pull requests, and issue tracking.
• Test, debug, optimize, and deploy applications; help monitor performance and resolve production issues.
Required Skills and Qualifications
• Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and responsive web design.
• Experience with at least one frontend framework or library, preferably React.
• Experience developing backend applications and REST APIs.
• Working knowledge of SQL and database design; familiarity with a NoSQL database is an advantage.
• Understanding of authentication, authorization, web security fundamentals, and API integration.
• Familiarity with Git, debugging tools, and basic software testing.
• Clear communication, problem-solving skills, and ability to work effectively with a team.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with TypeScript, Next.js, Docker, CI/CD, or cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
• Familiarity with automated testing frameworks and application performance optimization.
• A portfolio, internship, academic project, or deployed application demonstrating full-stack development.
Education and Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical
experience. Suitable for entry-level to mid-level applicants; relevant project experience may be considered in place of
professional experience.
Employment Details
Experience
0–3 years (flexible)
Location
To be confirmed
Work Mode
On-site / Hybrid / Remote
Compensation
As per company policy
Reports To
Engineering Lead / Manager
Type
Full-time
Application Process
Submit a resume and links to relevant projects or portfolio. Shortlisted candidates may be invited for a technical discussion
and interview.
